description: This file defines the OpenAiCompatibleResponsesHandler class, which manages interactions with OpenAI's API, including creating messages, handling responses, and processing streaming events. It supports different API configurations such as Azure and standard OpenAI endpoints, and includes methods for formatting conversations and managing API costs.

classes.name: OpenAiCompatibleResponsesHandler
classes.description: A class that handles communication with OpenAI's API, supporting streaming responses, conversation formatting, and error handling, with support for Azure and standard OpenAI endpoints.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Generates a message stream based on system prompt, messages, and optional metadata.

methods.name: handleResponsesApiMessage
methods.description: Handles the API message response, builds request body, and manages streaming response.

methods.name: buildRequestBody
methods.description: Constructs the request payload for the OpenAI responses API based on model, conversation, and options.

methods.name: executeRequest
methods.description: Executes the API request, manages streaming, and fallback error handling.

methods.name: formatFullConversation
methods.description: Formats conversation messages into the structure expected by the API.

methods.name: makeResponsesApiRequest
methods.description: Performs a fallback API request to the Responses endpoint if SDK streaming fails.

methods.name: processEvent
methods.description: Processes individual streaming events from the API, yielding text, reasoning, or tool call data.

methods.name: normalizeUsage
methods.description: Normalizes API usage data into a standardized format.

methods.name: getModel
methods.description: Returns the current model configuration with parameters.

methods.name: completePrompt
methods.description: Completes a prompt by sending it to the API and returning the generated text.

methods.name: _getUrlHost
methods.description: Extracts the host from a URL string.

methods.name: _isAzureAiInference
methods.description: Determines if the URL points to Azure AI inference endpoint.
